description: Get the current best chain from the live daemon. Returns per-block headers + transaction counts (always within budget) — use get_block for a specific block's transactions. detail:"full" returns complete blocks and may overflow on busy networks.

detail.description: Output size. "lite" (default): block header + transaction counts only — always within budget. "transactions": header + a page of userCommands (see transactionLimit/Offset). "full": the complete daemon response — may overflow the tool budget on busy networks.

maxLength.description: Maximum number of blocks to return

name: get_best_chain
